raw_response:
I've been working these 4.1 mu for more than fifty years, so I do not need to think too hard — I mostly follow what worked last year. My wife and I are the only ones left at home, so I cannot do everything myself and must plan carefully.

I split my land this way: about 1 mu for cotton on the sandier corner, 3.1 mu for the wheat-maize rotation on the better ground. That is how I have done it for many years and it suits the soil.

**Winter wheat (3.1 mu):** I sow in early October, improved variety — I buy Jimai seed from the county input store, same as most neighbors in our village. I plough before sowing because the stubble needs turning in; rotary alone leaves the ground too loose for wheat roots. I put down about 40 kg of diammonium phosphate as base fertilizer per mu, then top-dress with urea at jointing in spring, maybe 20 kg urea. So roughly 18 kg pure N, 8 kg P, and I add 5 kg of potassium sulfate because the agro-tech man at the village meeting said our soil is short on potash. I irrigate 3 times from the well — before winter, at jointing, and at grain filling. Pesticide I spray twice: once for aphids, once combined with the flag-leaf spray for rust and powdery mildew. I expect about 450 kg per mu, which is what I got last year.

**Summer maize (3.1 mu):** Right after wheat harvest in June I do no-tillage direct seeding — hire the machine for 30 yuan per mu, saves my old back. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Xianyu, whatever the dealer has fresh. I apply about 20 kg pure N (mostly urea side-dressed at the big trumpet stage), 6 kg P, 4 kg K. Irrigate once or twice depending on rain — usually once at tasseling. One pesticide spray for corn borer. I should get 550 kg per mu.

**Cotton (1 mu):** Cotton is troublesome and prices are not good, but I keep growing it because the sandy corner does not grow wheat well. Improved Bt variety so I do not fight bollworm like we used to. Plough in spring, plastic mulch, sow in late April. About 12 kg N, 6 kg P, 5 kg K, split between base and topdressing at budding. Irrigate 2 times from the well. Spray 3 times for aphids and mirid bugs. I expect around 220 kg seed cotton per mu — cotton yield has been dropping but at my age I do not want to change everything.
